ttl.name: Front Shock Absorber w/ Coil Spring

s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Front Shock Absorber Assembly LH

s3.ptxt: With the piston rod extended, place the shock absorber horizontally, and using a hacksaw or equivalent, make a hole between A and B as shown in the illustration to release the gas.

item.ptxt: The gas released is colorless, odorless and non-toxic.
As chips may fly out due to the force of the gas, cover the hacksaw with a shop rag or equivalent when making the hole.
